class.name: HEGoTextureInputNode
class.brief_description: Uploads a Godot [Image] or [Texture2D] as a Houdini Copernicus layer.
class.description:
Call [method set_image] or [method set_texture] in an active session to create the input and upload its pixels. Keep this object while the HDA uses it. Updating the same object preserves its Houdini output connection.
Connect the texture with [method HEGoTransformableInputReceiverNode.connect_input]. A SOP input receives one point at the origin with a string attribute named [code]hego_cop_path[/code]. Read that attribute in the COP Path of a Fetch COP inside the HDA. A compatible COP HDA input receives the image layer directly. Use [method HEGoMergeNode.connect_inputs] to send several texture points to a SOP socket. HDAs with an explicit COP node-reference parameter can also use [method HEGoAssetNode.set_node_parm].
The upload uses the base mip level and preserves one to four channels. Choose the encoding of the actual pixel values. A luminance-alpha image is transferred as two components in luminance, alpha order.

method.name: set_image
method.description: Captures [param image] when called and uploads its finite samples as linear floats. The task returns the Houdini output node ID. Repeating the same image and encoding reuses the existing upload. Pass [param force] to upload again. An empty image, an unsupported image format, or a compressed format Godot cannot decode fails the task.

method.name: set_texture
method.description: Reads the current base-level image with [method Texture2D.get_image] and submits it through [method set_image]. Reading a GPU texture can incur a readback. Use [method set_image] when CPU pixels are already available. The task fails if [param texture] cannot supply an image.

constants.constant: Upload samples with their existing linear values. Use for masks, roughness, normal vectors, or color that is already linear.
Decode sRGB-encoded color components to linear values before upload. Alpha retains its original linear value.
